page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.6xlarge is a dedicated compute instance belonging to the high clock speed ecs.hfg5 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. The system is equipped with 24 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 6149 processors running at a base clock frequency of 3.1 GHz. System memory totals 96.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

Network infrastructure provides a baseline throughput of 4 Gbps. The instance contains no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached cloud disks for persistent storage and the host operating system. The configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses and operates without discrete graphics accelerators or specialized matrix coprocessors.

The combination of dedicated 3.1 GHz clock cycles and balanced memory capacity makes this configuration viable for sustained enterprise application tiers. Best-fit deployments include mid-tier relational database hosting, container orchestration nodes, backend web serving, build automation, and general compute-heavy batch processing pipelines.
